scorecard.rationale: The 2023 abstract favors refined sesame oil against refined sunflower oil on depressive symptoms during weight loss. The exact test for p=.013, arm estimates and effects of cold-pressed oil are unavailable. The 2025 biomarker report and 2022 companion papers share the trial lineage without an additional depression result. A Parkinson cannabinoid trial used sesame oil in both arms and did not isolate its effect. The indirect human comparison retains a minimal easing lean.
